policy: All dimension relationships use whole-number surrogate keys.
Key 0 represents an unresolved, missing, suppressed, or unavailable dimension member.
Missing dimension values map to key 0 rather than removing the discharge.
Released business identifiers remain available as descriptive dimension attributes.
Surrogate and foreign keys are hidden from report users.
The model does not invent a durable patient or discharge identifier.
The initial date key represents discharge year only.
Before appending additional years, test dimension attribute stability and key reuse across years.
